name: smwmusic-final-fantasy-vii-those-who-fight-further
title: Final Fantasy VII - Those Who Fight Further
description:
(Also known as "Fight On!" or "Still More Fighting")

The well-known boss battle theme from Final Fantasy VII, now in SMW.

Please note that, because of the big amount of samples and their size, this isn't compatible with Yoshi's SFX nor the "Thunder" (explosion) SFX.
It's not compatible with the original P-Switch music either.
